ideas.title: The Scope of SNAP Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of SNAP fraud in Minnesota, focusing on the $1.1 million scheme involving Minnesota Food Grocery and potential connections to other fraud schemes.
questions: How widespread is SNAP fraud in Minnesota?
What are the connections between Minnesota Food Grocery and other potential fraud schemes?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of SNAP fraud in Minnesota and potentially lead to further investigations and charges.
